Bid: Transforming the UK’s death/grief culture; through creative writing
Name: Rebecca Althaus
Role/Bio: Project Lead, facilitator & mentor: Rebecca is a poet, performer, and creative researcher in the field of death and grief studies, and is currently writing a poetry collection on the theme of identity after bereavement and how ‘place’ interacts with grief. She also hosts and supports fellow writers. She previously worked for over twenty years as a body therapist and teacher, organising and facilitating postgraduate days for therapists and women’s workshops.

Bid: Transforming the UK’s death/grief culture; through creative writing
Name: Rosie Hadden

She is also part of None Dies Alone in Cornwall.

Name: The Alt Haus Writer's Cabin
Role/Bio: The Alt Haus Writer's Cabin is a simple space to be, to think, to dream, to create, to rest. A purpose-built place for writers, to stay in all seasons. Located on the high moor of the Penwith peninsula at the westernmost end of Cornwall. Wild and raw, circled by massive views of land and sea and sky, with wonderful walks. The Alt Haus is managed by Rebecca and will host 12 fully funded residencies across 2 years.
